sip.acceptance_criteria: Recover accepts one exact disposition only for an absent registered target with closed-out terminal truth and no cleanup operation; records no-effect historical truth; present, dirty, mismatched, unregistered, nonterminal, pending, and ambiguous cases fail closed.
sip.demo_proof_requirements: Deterministic installed local Git fixture; no external service or paid runner is required.
sip.goal: Reconcile terminal cleanup truth when a closed merged issue's exact registered checkout was removed outside native cleanup before any RecordCleanup operation was reserved.
sip.inputs: Issue #1041, the blocked #978 closeout, canonical authority, exact binding identity, terminal receipt, live closed merged GitHub truth, and semantic terminal state.
sip.non_goals: No silent cleanup success, no fabricated performed deletion, no general missing-worktree bypass, and no weakening of ordinary clean admission.
sip.notes_risks: The route repairs bookkeeping after external removal, so its durable outcome must distinguish no effect from a native-performed deletion and bind every authority input exactly.
sip.required_outcome: An explicit operator disposition can record an authenticated already-absent cleanup outcome without claiming that native cleanup performed the removal.
sip.target_files_surfaces: C-SDLC v3 terminal recovery intent plus focused installed semantic cleanup regressions.
